function.name: compare_similar_mols
function.description: Retrieve text-form local analog evidence. The input SMILES must belong to the active task dataset so the tool can identify the query split and retrieve the nearest training-set neighbors. The tool returns plain text with a short definition of query/neighbor/delta, then positive and negative neighbors (2 positive and 2 negative), each with neighbor/query/delta values for the 36 dense properties plus functional-group differences.

smiles.description: SMILES string for the molecule to analyze.
